refinements.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT this Puff Slayers 12-frame Carrot Knight ultimate sprite sheet to fix CELL SPACING ONLY. Keep the SAME Tofu shiba inu design, all twelve poses in identical sequence, red scarf, samurai armor, carrot sword, painterly Japanese anime style and orange-gold VFX. The current image is beautiful but incorrect for game slicing: sword tips, flames and debris cross the invisible grid boundaries. Production requirement: image aspect 4:3, EXACT 4 columns × 3 rows of equal SQUARE cells. Uniform #E8E8E8 backdrop, no shadows.
CRITICAL CORRECTION: scale each complete drawing (character + entire sword + EVERY flame, rock, sparkle and dust) down to 70% of its present size, place at the center of its OWN cell. ALL content in every cell must be inside the inner 76% width and inner 76% height: leave at least 12% of each cell width COMPLETELY EMPTY on left/right and at least 12% of each cell height COMPLETELY EMPTY on top/bottom. Continuous empty gray corridors must separate all rows and columns. Do NOT fill these corridors with speed lines, debris, dust, flames or weapon tips. No artwork whatsoever at grid lines x=25%,50%,75% image width and y=33.333%,66.666% image height. Do not draw grid lines. The biggest impact effect in frame 9 must ALSO fit safely within its own cell at this smaller scale. Keep character's head diameter and body size identical across all cells. Feet align at 73% of cell height except lifted/jumping poses. All characters face right at 55 degree top-down view. Maintain exactly ONE character per cell, no duplicates. Remove ALL floor shadows, keep blank backdrop perfectly flat. NO panels, no labels, no text, no numbers, no visible separators. Entire blade and flame fully visible inside each frame, not cropped. This is a game animation asset that will be cut at exact equal quarter-width and third-height boundaries. Preserve the twelve-frame choreography and make space for cutting.

Background is perfectly uniform flat light gray #E8E8E8, no gradient, no shadows, no objects behind. Crisp effects with restrained glow. No characters, no text, no labels, no numbers, no borders or grid lines. Match the seven-cell equal spacing precisely.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production chibi anime web-game ultimate animation SPRITE SHEET, Puff Slayers Carrot Knight — Carrot Crescent. References: Image 1 is Tofu's identity MODEL SHEET, Image 2 is Tofu's pose set for facing direction, same outfit and weapon. Draw EXACTLY the same orange round fluffy shiba inu puff, cream muzzle and eyebrow spots, triangle ears, curled cream tail, red paw-marked scarf, dark light samurai armor trimmed bronze, red cords, enormous glowing orange carrot greatsword with green leaves at hilt. Keep face, body, costume and sword IDENTICAL across every frame. Japanese anime movie quality, hand-painted cinematic look, semi-realistic painterly anime style, subtle clean linework, soft cel-painted shapes, visible brush texture, peach-orange highlights and cool teal-blue shadows, illustrated, not photorealistic, not 3D. High top-down 55 degree camera, character faces RIGHT throughout (3/4 right view, never frontal).
LAYOUT IS CRITICAL: a landscape 4:3 image, ideally 2048x1536, strictly FOUR COLUMNS by THREE ROWS = EXACTLY TWELVE equal SQUARE cells; no other panels. Every cell has one full small character and its own action effects. Same body size (head about 20% of cell width) in every cell; enough empty padding all around. Standing feet baseline at 74% of cell height, torso horizontally centered at 50%; airborne frames lift upward at same x. Effects must fit completely within that cell, leave 6% empty gutter at EVERY cell boundary. Uniform plain flat light gray #E8E8E8 throughout. No floor shadows, no grid lines, no labels, no numbers or text. Read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. This is ONE continuous animation, not twelve unrelated illustrations.
TWELVE FRAMES IN EXACT ORDER:
Row 1 cells 1–4: 1 crouching low gripping the carrot sword with a small glint (no large effect); 2 sword pulled back, orange embers gathering along blade; 3 lunging toward the right with sharp speed lines and a dust burst behind (keep torso centred); 4 wide horizontal slash with a thick-to-thin orange crescent smear extending right.
Row 2 cells 5–8: 5 spinning for a rising backhand slash with second crescent; 6 springing into air in full spin wrapped in a ring of flame; 7 at top of leap, sword raised overhead blazing gold, body higher but SAME body size; 8 plunging down with large vertical crescent smear, sword pointing down-right.
Row 3 cells 9–12: 9 IMPACT largest effect in sheet: sword slams into ground, giant flaming crescent wave bursts outward, cracked earth and flying rocks, full character still visible and same size; 10 fire wave rolling rightward while embers rain, character at landing baseline; 11 kneeling follow-through with sword glowing, dwindling embers; 12 standing up, sword resting on shoulder, proud grin, little final sparkle.
VFX painted together with the character in each cell: crisp thick-head thin-tail crescent smear arcs, white-hot core, orange #FF6A2B middle, gold/deep orange edge, sparkles and debris. Sharp energy edges with NO fog or haze blending into background. No extra characters, no duplicated limbs, no sword changes, no camera zoom, no overlapping adjacent cells.
